advisory.finding: The producer column for RELEASE_DELTA in docs/event-schema.md is now out of date. It still says 'Tests only in schema version 6'. advisory.finding: No test covers the new run_differs payload line that passes InboundMutation.releases into the typed inbound-update Mutation. advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] In test_release_delta_leaves_tags_alone, assert a RELEASE_DELTA was written before asserting the TAG_DELTA absence
evidence: tests/unit/reconciler/mutate/test_inbound_apply_releases.py:141: `assert not [p for p in (tracker_dir / local_id).glob("*-TAG_DELTA.json")]` — an absence-only check with no presence check from the same apply
advisory.finding: test_release_delta_leaves_tags_alone only asserts that no TAG_DELTA file exists. It never checks that the release apply actually wrote a RELEASE_DELTA, so it also passes when the release path wrote nothing at all.
scenarios: The release apply short-circuits (for example, the reducer returns None, or the payload key is wrong) and writes no events. 'No TAG_DELTA' is then trivially true, and the test reports that releases leave tags alone without having exercised a release write.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add `assert _release_deltas(tracker_dir / local_id) == [{"added": ["2.4"], "removed": [], "source": "inbound"}]` before the TAG_DELTA absence assertion.
